_comment: Template for Spinr MCP server configuration. Do NOT commit real keys. Copy the block(s) you want into .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored) under a top-level 'mcpServers' key, replacing the ${...} placeholders with real values from 1Password / settings.

supabase._comment: Read-only Supabase MCP. Use a service key with row-level read access scoped to non-PII tables, OR use the anon key restricted by RLS. NEVER put the service role key here — that bypasses RLS and defeats PIPEDA guardrails.

context7._comment: Context7 for up-to-date library documentation (FastAPI, Supabase, Stripe, Expo, Next.js). Free tier is fine for read-only docs; no user data ever leaves to this service.

stripe._comment: Official Stripe MCP. Use a RESTRICTED, TEST-MODE secret key (sk_test_...) scoped to the minimum resources needed — never the live secret key or an unrestricted key. Verifying webhook/idempotency fixes against real event payloads is the main use case; it should never touch live customer charges from an editor session.

vercel._comment: Official Vercel MCP — remote server, OAuth on first connect (no key to store here). Gives read access to admin-dashboard's deployments/build logs. The OAuth flow authorizes whatever Vercel account/team you sign in with, so use a team member scoped to this project if you don't want broader org access.
